pyjhora_details.name: Rogagrastha Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: The Lagna lord is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house and is associated with the lord of the 6th.

pyjhora_details.name: Krisanga Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: Lagna lord in a dry sign or in a sign owned by a dry planet.

pyjhora_details.name: Dehasthoulya Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: Lagna Lord and its Navamsa Lord both occupy watery signs (in Rasi).

pyjhora_details.name: Dehasthoulya Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: Jupiter in Lagna OR Jupiter aspects Lagna from a watery sign.

pyjhora_details.name: Sada Sanchara Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: The Lagna lord or the Moon is in a movable sign (Chara Rashi).

pyjhora_details.name: Swaveeryaddhana Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: The Lagna lord is the strongest planet in the chart and is placed in a Kendra, associated with the 2nd lord.

pyjhora_details.name: Sumukha Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: Benefic planets (Jupiter, Venus) are placed in or aspecting the 2nd house.

pyjhora_details.name: Bhratruvriddhi Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: The 3rd lord or Mars is associated with a benefic planet or placed in a benefic sign/Navamsha.

pyjhora_details.name: Dwadasa Sahodara Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: The 3rd lord is in a kendra and exalted Mars joins Jupiter in a thrikona from the 3rd lord.

pyjhora_details.name: Yuddha Praveena Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: The lord of the Navamsa occupied by the 3rd lord's Navamsa lord is placed in its own Varga.

pyjhora_details.name: Bandhu Pujya Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: 194 - The 4th house or the 4th lord should have the association or aspect of Jupiter.

pyjhora_details.name: Bandhu Bhisthyaktha Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: 195. The 4th lord must be associated with malefics or occupy evil shashtiamsas or join inimical or debilitation signs.

pyjhora_details.name: Maathru Naasa yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: 198 - The Moon should be hemmed in between, associated with or aspected by evil planets.

pyjhora_details.name: Kapata Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: 202 - The 4th house must be joined by a malefic and the 4rh lord must be associated with or aspected by malefics or be hemmed in between malefics.

pyjhora_details.name: Nishkapata Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: 205 - The 4th house must be occupied by a benefic, or a planet in exaltation, friendly or own house,or the 4th house must be a benefic sign.

pyjhora_details.name: Maathru Sneha Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: First Variation - The Lagna (1st house) and the 4th house have the same planetary ruler. The lst and 4th houses can have common lords only in respect of Ge/Vi (Me) or Sg/Pi (Ju). Second Variation - The lords of the 1st and 4th houses are either natural or temporal friends. Third Variation - The Lagna lord (1st house ruler) and the 4th house lord are aspected by benefics.

pyjhora_details.name: Vaahana Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: 209 - The lord of Lagna must join the 4th, 11th or the 9th.

pyjhora_details.name: Bahu Puthra Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: 221 - The same yoga arises if the lord of the Navamsa occupied by a planet who is in association with the 7th lord is in the 1st, 2nd or 5th house. Steps: (1) Get 7th Lord in Rasi. (2) Find which rasi this 7th lord is in Navamsa chart. (3) Find the lord of that sign of step-2. (4) Find the sign of the Lord found from step-3 in rasi chart. (5) That sign should be either 1st, or 2nd or 5th from Lagna in rasi

pyjhora_details.name: Kaalanirdesat Puthranaasa Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: 230 - Malefics should be disposed (cojoins or aspect) in 5th from Jupiter and 5th from Lagna

pyjhora_details.name: Buddhimaturya Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: 231 - If the 5th lord, being a benefic, is either aspected by another benefic or occupies a benefic sign, the above yoga is given rise to.

pyjhora_details.name: Sathkalatra Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: 239 - The lord of the 7th or Venus should join or be aspected by Jupiter or Mercury.

pyjhora_details.name: Mathibhramana Yoga
pyjhora_details.desc: This yoga occurs, per B.V.Raman Variations, if - (1) The 6th is occupied by Rahu and aspected by Kethu. (2) The 6th lord is further affiicted by conjunction with Mars. (3) The planet of nerves Mercury is in a common sign in conjunction with two malefics, Mars and Sun. (4) In the Navamsa again Mercury occupies the 6th with Rahu and the 6th lord is in conjunction with Mars.
